procedure: In the same instrumented app, reopened the generated rotated MPOLYGON, selected its one model-space entity, scaled by 2 about (0,0), and saved a separate AC1018 ASCII file. The save displayed the MPOLYGON-to-HATCH and separate boundary-color loss notes; the app reopened the resulting HATCH.
independent_readback: ezdxf 1.4.5 verified one MPOLYGON source and one HATCH output, HATCH color ACI 3, and all three world-space vertices scaled by 2 within 1e-12. Both files audited with zero errors and zero fixes.
limits: App uses scratch GL tracing, isolated title and identity, and project Lua action scripts attached to its scratch bundle; it is not a release binary. Loaded persistence, viewer and kernel libraries were verified via lsof.
The window screenshot remained black; no uninstrumented visible-display claim or post-reopen framebuffer capture is made.

One locally generated solid, explicit-ACI, default-normal AC1018 polygon and uniform scale are covered. The output is a HATCH and separate boundary color is not retained. Other profiles, independent producers, Linux and Windows remain open.
